fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Saudi Arabia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la fecha en que llegues a Arabia Saudita.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive

entry.en: You may not be allowed to enter Saudi Arabia if your passport shows travel to, or birth in, Israel.
entry.es: Es posible que no te dejen entrar a Arabia Saudita si tu pasaporte muestra viajes a Israel o nacimiento en Israel.
entry.quote: You may not be allowed to enter Saudi Arabia if your passport shows that you have travelled to, or were born in, Israel.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccine certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país listado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: yellow fever vaccine if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk

entry.en: Alcoholic beverages, pork products, non-Islamic religious materials and pornographic materials must not be brought in.
entry.es: No se debe llevar bebidas alcohólicas, productos de cerdo, material religioso no islámico ni material pornográfico.
entry.quote: Do not bring alcoholic beverages, pork products, non-Islamic religious materials, or pornographic materials into Saudi Arabia.

entry.en: Visitors bringing in more than SR60,000 or its equivalent must fill out a declaration form.
entry.es: Quien ingrese más de 60.000 SR o su equivalente debe llenar un formulario de declaración.
entry.quote: Visitors bringing in more than SR60,000 or its equivalent must fill out a declaration form.

entry.en: Your visa may only allow you to enter Saudi Arabia by air.
entry.es: Tu visa podría permitirte entrar a Arabia Saudita solo por vía aérea.
entry.quote: Your visa may only allow you to enter Saudi Arabia by air.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to the rest of Saudi Arabia.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje no esencial al resto de Arabia Saudita.
safety.quote: all but essential travel to the rest of Saudi Arabia

safety.en: Since 13 July the Houthis have launched missiles and drones targeting several locations in Saudi Arabia.
safety.es: Desde el 13 de julio los hutíes han lanzado misiles y drones contra varios lugares de Arabia Saudita.
safety.quote: Since 13 July, the Houthis (a military group in Yemen) have launched missiles and drones targeting several locations in Saudi Arabia.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Saudi Arabia.
safety.es: Es probable que terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Arabia Saudita.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Saudi Arabia.

safety.en: There is zero tolerance for drug offences in Saudi Arabia, and the penalties are severe.
safety.es: Hay tolerancia cero con los delitos de drogas en Arabia Saudita y las penas son severas.
safety.quote: There is zero tolerance for drug offences in Saudi Arabia, and the penalties are severe.

safety.en: Standards of driving are poor and there are a high number of serious accidents on the roads.
safety.es: El nivel de conducción es malo y hay muchos accidentes graves en las carreteras.
safety.quote: Standards of driving are poor and there are a high number of serious accidents on the roads.

safety.en: Same-sex relations are illegal, although legal action is uncommon.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo son ilegales, aunque rara vez hay acciones legales.
safety.quote: Same-sex relations are illegal, although legal action is uncommon.

health.en: Healthcare facilities in major Saudi cities are of a high standard.
health.es: Los centros de salud de las grandes ciudades saudíes son de alto nivel.
health.quote: Healthcare facilities in major Saudi cities are of a high standard.

health.en: There is an increased risk of heat stroke and dehydration during the summer months.
health.es: Hay mayor riesgo de golpe de calor y deshidratación en los meses de verano.
health.quote: There is an increased risk of heat stroke and dehydration during the summer months.

health.en: Some prescribed or over-the-counter medicines are controlled substances in Saudi Arabia.
health.es: Algunos medicamentos con receta o de venta libre son sustancias controladas en Arabia Saudita.
health.quote: In Saudi Arabia some prescribed or over-the-counter medicines are controlled substances.

health.en: UK prescriptions are not accepted in Saudi Arabia.
health.es: Las recetas del Reino Unido no se aceptan en Arabia Saudita.
health.quote: UK prescriptions are not accepted in Saudi Arabia.

health.en: Tap water in the major cities is generally considered safe, though not always tasty.
health.es: El agua del grifo en las grandes ciudades se considera en general segura, aunque no siempre agradable.
health.quote: Tap water in the major cities is generally considered safe, although it's not always particularly tasty

health.en: No vaccinations are required for general travel to the Kingdom.
health.es: No se exigen vacunas para viajes generales al Reino.
health.quote: No vaccinations are required for general travel to the Kingdom

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

help.en: If you do not have a Saudi SIM card, call 112 in an emergency.
help.es: Si no tienes una SIM saudita, llama al 112 en una emergencia.
help.quote: If you do not have a Saudi SIM card, call 112 in an emergency.

getting_in.en: Saudi Arabia has four major international airports, at Riyadh, Jeddah, Medina and Dammam.
getting_in.es: Arabia Saudita tiene cuatro grandes aeropuertos internacionales: Riad, Yeda, Medina y Dammam.
getting_in.quote: Saudi Arabia has four major international airports at Riyadh, Jeddah, Medina, and Dammam

getting_in.en: Dhahran airport is closed to civil traffic, so passengers to the Eastern Region fly into Dammam or nearby Bahrain.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Dhahran está cerrado al tráfico civil, así que a la región oriental se llega por Dammam o la cercana Bahréin.
getting_in.quote: The airport at Dhahran is now closed to civil traffic, so passengers to the Eastern Region now fly into Dammam, or into nearby Bahrain

getting_in.en: The most popular bus route runs between Dammam/Khobar and Manama, Bahrain, several times daily for SR60.
getting_in.es: La ruta de bus más popular une Dammam/Khobar con Manama (Bahréin), varias veces al día por 60 SR.
getting_in.quote: Probably the most popular service is between Dammam/Khobar and Manama, Bahrain. There are several services daily at a cost of SR60 or 6 Bahraini dinars

getting_in.en: SAT operates cross-border bus services to most of Saudi Arabia's neighbors and beyond.
getting_in.es: SAT opera buses transfronterizos a la mayoría de los vecinos de Arabia Saudita y más allá.
getting_in.quote: operates cross-border bus services to most of Saudi Arabia's neighbors and beyond

getting_in.en: Automobile crossings exist on nearly all the borders.
getting_in.es: Hay pasos fronterizos para automóviles en casi todas las fronteras.
getting_in.quote: Automobile crossings exist on nearly all the borders.

getting_in.en: Passenger ferries run daily from Port Safaga in Egypt.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris de pasajeros diarios desde Port Safaga, en Egipto.
getting_in.quote: Passenger ferries run daily from Port Safaga in Egypt.

getting_around.en: Flying is the main means of long-distance travel, although trains are starting to compete on some routes.
getting_around.es: Volar es el principal medio para largas distancias, aunque los trenes empiezan a competir en algunas rutas.
getting_around.quote: Saudi Arabia is a large country, which makes flying the only main means of long-distance travel (although trains are starting to offer serious competition on some routes).

getting_around.en: The Riyadh-Dammam bus costs SR60 and takes around 6 hours.
getting_around.es: El bus Riad-Dammam cuesta 60 SR y tarda unas 6 horas.
getting_around.quote: The Riyadh-Dammam service, for example, costs SR60 and takes around 6 hours.

getting_around.en: Online train tickets are available for all services, and it is advisable to buy in advance as trains are often sold out.
getting_around.es: Hay boletos de tren en línea para todos los servicios y conviene comprar con anticipación porque los trenes suelen agotarse.
getting_around.quote: Online tickets are available for all services. It is advisable to buy tickets in advance as the trains are often sold out (though a waiting list option exists)

getting_around.en: Uber or Careem are an easy option in cities, at about SR 30-35 for 15 km in Riyadh.
getting_around.es: Uber o Careem son una opción fácil en las ciudades, unos 30-35 SR por 15 km en Riad.
getting_around.quote: Another option, easy to use, is to use an app like Uber or Careem - should be about SR 30-35/15 km in Riyadh.

getting_around.en: The area around Mecca is off limits to non-Muslims, and the exclusion zone is well signposted.
getting_around.es: La zona alrededor de La Meca está vedada a los no musulmanes y la zona de exclusión está bien señalizada.
getting_around.quote: The area around Mecca is off limits to non-Muslims; the exclusion zone is well signposted

getting_around.en: After a car accident all parties must stay put and wait for the Traffic Police (call 993), which can take up to four hours.
getting_around.es: Tras un accidente de auto todos deben quedarse y esperar a la Policía de Tráfico (993), lo que puede tardar hasta cuatro horas.
getting_around.quote: If you are involved in a car accident all parties are required to stay where they are and wait for the Traffic Police (call 993) to turn up, which can take up to four hours.

money.en: The Saudi currency is the Saudi riyal.
money.es: La moneda de Arabia Saudita es el riyal saudí.
money.quote: The Saudi currency is the Saudi riyal, denoted by the symbol

money.en: Saudi Arabia is still largely a cash society, and some smaller businesses refuse cards for small amounts.
money.es: Arabia Saudita sigue siendo en gran medida una sociedad de efectivo y algunos comercios pequeños rechazan tarjetas en montos bajos.
money.quote: Saudi Arabia is still largely a cash society. Larger businesses will accept all cards, however most smaller businesses accept debit and credit cards but some will refuse if the amount is small.

money.en: ATMs are ubiquitous, but those of many smaller banks do not accept foreign cards.
money.es: Los cajeros son omnipresentes, pero los de muchos bancos pequeños no aceptan tarjetas extranjeras.
money.quote: ATMs are ubiquitous, although those of many smaller banks do not accept foreign cards

money.en: Tipping is generally not expected, although service staff are always happy to receive it.
money.es: Generalmente no se espera propina, aunque el personal de servicio siempre la agradece.
money.quote: Tipping is generally not expected, although service staff are always happy to receive them

money.en: Bargaining is the norm in most small to medium-sized stores.
money.es: Regatear es lo normal en la mayoría de las tiendas pequeñas y medianas.
money.quote: Bargaining is a norm in most small to medium-sized stores.

money.en: Daily travel costs are figured at about US$50 for budget, US$100 for midrange and US$200 for splurge travel.
money.es: Los costos diarios se calculan en unos US$50 (económico), US$100 (medio) y US$200 (lujo).
money.quote: Prices are generally fairly high: figure on US$50/100/200 for budget, midrange and splurge-level daily travel costs.

etiquette.en: The standard dress code for foreign men is long trousers and a long-sleeved shirt.
etiquette.es: El código de vestimenta habitual para hombres extranjeros es pantalón largo y camisa de manga larga.
etiquette.quote: the standard dress code for foreign men in Saudi Arabia is long trousers and a long-sleeved shirt

etiquette.en: Women are not required to cover their face, but are strongly advised to cover their hair and wear modest clothing.
etiquette.es: A las mujeres no se les exige cubrirse el rostro, pero se les aconseja mucho cubrirse el cabello y vestir con modestia.
etiquette.quote: Women are not required to cover their face in public, though you are still strongly advised to cover your hair with a hijab, and wear modest clothing that covers your limbs and conceals your body figure.

etiquette.en: Photographing Saudi people without permission is punishable by a SR1000 fine.
etiquette.es: Fotografiar a personas saudíes sin permiso se castiga con una multa de 1000 SR.
etiquette.quote: Taking pictures of Saudi people without their permission will upset them and is punishable by a SR1000 fine, and you will be asked to delete the photographs you've taken.

etiquette.en: During Ramadan you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking and chewing in public during daylight hours.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán debes abstenerte de comer, beber, fumar y masticar en público durante las horas de luz.
etiquette.quote: During Ramadan, you should refrain from eating, drinking, smoking, and chewing in public during daylight hours.

etiquette.en: Utensils are not used when eating, and people tend to eat with their right hand because the left is considered unclean.
etiquette.es: No se usan cubiertos para comer y se suele comer con la mano derecha, pues la izquierda se considera impura.
etiquette.quote: Utensils are not used when eating. People tend to eat with their right hands. The left hand is considered unclean.

etiquette.en: It would be wise not to discuss religion at all, since speaking negatively about it easily draws strong responses.
etiquette.es: Sería prudente no hablar de religión, pues hablar mal de ella provoca fácilmente reacciones fuertes.
etiquette.quote: You can very easily elicit strong responses by speaking negatively about religion, especially from an agnostic point of view. It would be wise to not discuss religion at all.

connectivity.en: A prepaid SIM starter pack starts from about SR75 and you can sign up in most larger mobile shops with your passport.
connectivity.es: Un paquete de SIM prepago cuesta desde unos 75 SR y puedes contratarlo en la mayoría de las tiendas móviles grandes con tu pasaporte.
connectivity.quote: A starter pack with prepaid SIM and talktime starts from about SR75, and you can sign up in most any larger mobile shop (bring your passport).

connectivity.en: Google, WhatsApp, Wikipedia and all major webmail and social media platforms are accessible in the country.
connectivity.es: Google, WhatsApp, Wikipedia y los principales servicios de correo y redes sociales son accesibles en el país.
connectivity.quote: Google, WhatsApp, Wikipedia, and all major webmail providers and social media platforms are accessible in the country.

connectivity.en: WhatsApp video calls were unblocked in February 2025 after six years of being forbidden.
connectivity.es: Las videollamadas de WhatsApp se desbloquearon en febrero de 2025 tras seis años de prohibición.
connectivity.quote: WhatsApp video calls were unblocked in February 2025 after six years of being forbidden.

connectivity.en: Websites critical of Islam, human rights sites, LGBTQ+ sites and gambling sites, among others, are banned.
connectivity.es: Están bloqueados sitios críticos del islam, de derechos humanos, LGBTQ+ y de apuestas, entre otros.
connectivity.quote: websites critical of Islam, human rights websites, websites promoting religions other than Islam, LGBTQ+ websites, gambling websites, dirty humour websites, and websites promoting Israel are banned in Saudi Arabia.

connectivity.en: It is illegal to operate a blog, forum, online news outlet or chat room without a special license.
connectivity.es: Es ilegal operar un blog, foro, medio de noticias en línea o chat sin una licencia especial.
connectivity.quote: It is illegal to operate a blog, forum, an online news outlet, or a chat room without a special license from the Saudi Ministry of Culture and Information.
